scientific_integrity: The proof derives an exact restricted Dirichlet series on a finite prime-generated monoid from Fink's positive convolution expansion. A pole at the unique \(\alpha_Q>1\) with \(Z_Q(\alpha_Q)=2\) contradicts the finite bound that would follow from \(a(n)\le n\) on the whole support. The all-\(k\) corollary then uses only divergence of the prime Euler product; computation is not used for existence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is existential and supplies no effective bound for the least ample number on a qualifying support or avoiding the first \(k\) primes. The Euler-product inequality is sufficient and is not claimed necessary.
title: Finite abundant prime supports force ample numbers
